sentences.en: She studies hygiene as part of her domestic science course.
sentences.zh: 她在家庭科学课程中学习卫生学。

sentences.en: I prefer not to neglect the rules of personal hygiene.
sentences.zh: 我不愿意忽视个人卫生规则。

sentences.en: Poor personal hygiene can be a sign of depression.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的个人卫生可能是抑郁症的一个迹象。
